arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 -I entry.py < /app/examples/basic.json > /workspace/tmp/out.json; echo "exit=$?"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, difflib
out = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/out.json'))
exp = json.load(open('/app/examples/basic.expected.json'))
print("MATCH" if out == exp else "DIFF")
if out != exp:
    a = json.dumps(out, indent=1).splitlines()
    b = json.dumps(exp, indent=1).splitlines()
    for line in difflib.unified_diff(b, a, 'expected', 'got', lineterm='', n=2):
        print(line)
EOF
